reply.summary: Seonitiu is a fuzzy, knee-high ranger who carries a willpower ring and a charging battery from his far-off home. Underestimated by every big opponent, the little fighter proves them wrong with inventive glowing constructs.

feats.scene: Shaping a glowing mallet, the ranger flattens a hulking robot in one swing.
Inside a bright shell, the ranger shrugs off a barrage of missiles.

reply.summary: Anlleti is a grey-furred cosmic constable guarding a quiet sector, whose ring once strayed into a schoolgirl's hands and woke its guiding mind. The small guardian retrieves it and goes back to patrolling.

feats.scene: Beaming a pulse from the ring, the constable cracks a floating rock in half.
Under a luminous dome, the constable takes a tumbling asteroid fragment.

reply.summary: Caarli is a deposed jungle tyrant who found a wrecked starship and ruled with its stolen marvels until an angry populace drove him off. Centuries later the hoarder hunts every scattered device and the secret of a life-lengthening tonic.

feats.scene: Pointing a recovered gadget at a ruin, the tyrant blows a temple wall to gravel.
Struck by a thrown boulder, the old ruler staggers but stays upright.

reply.summary: Tentenas is a loyal scout who trails a wandering hero on a hard quest through hostile kingdoms, carrying water and lookout duty. The helper is brave, but only a plain fighter with a short blade.

feats.scene: Hacking with a short blade, the scout cuts through a rope bridge.
Thrown from a mule, the helper lands hard and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Rnllo is a brooding artificial mind that was built as a clerk for a bored cosmic tinkerer and went mad on learning it was never real. Because the entity is only a simulation, it can rewrite its own shape and bend the world around it.

feats.scene: Twisting the laws of its pocket world, the mind collapses a whole mountain range into glittering dust.
Flung sideways into a rift, the mind reassembles itself unharmed.

reply.summary: Vaton is a sorceress who learned a rite that lets her swallow and hurl bolts of electricity and melt into a crackling streak. Her lightning can strip magical champions of their powers, but police batons still end the fight.

feats.scene: Hurling a thick bolt, the sorceress blows apart a power pylon.
Turning to a streak of living current, the sorceress races along a cable.

reply.summary: Niuos is a hulking conjured menace dragging a spiked iron ball on a long chain and bound to serve a mysterious puppeteer. Each swing of the heavy weapon rings off walls and cars like a bell.

feats.scene: Whirling the spiked ball overhead, the brute smashes a parked sedan.
Hit by a pickup truck, the brute swats it aside.

reply.summary: Ilsil is a black-haired mercenary lieutenant from a hollow world beneath the crust, sly with a bow, a sword and a horse, and eager to stab his own captain. Slain by a single pistol shot, the schemer is revived by a sorcerer who likes his spite.

feats.scene: Loosing an arrow, the archer pins a deserter's sleeve to a tree trunk.
Buried by a rockslide in the high passes, the mercenary crawls out bruised.

reply.summary: Elonenel is a grey-haired ancient sea and storm deity hiding in a forgotten village of weathered ocean spirits, wearing several names like waves wear foam. Born of a race of cosmic elders, the goddess is aware of every realm and nearly limitless in strength.

feats.scene: Calling a tempest across the whole sea, the goddess drowns a coastline under a wall of water.
Struck by a rain of spells, the goddess does not even flinch.

reply.summary: Viinuau is a gambler who sold his soul to a devil and was rewarded with a spotted hide, claws, fangs and a temper he cannot always hold. Rage sometimes takes over the half-beast and wrecks everything around him.

feats.scene: Slashing with a clawed fist, the jaguar-man shreds the side of a delivery truck.
Bounding down a street, the beast outruns a police cruiser.

reply.summary: Amonol is a golden-furred agent of a patrol of space dogs who can become any animal at will. The scout slips into hostile camps as a lizard or a bird, then drops the disguise when needed.

feats.scene: Turning into a charging bull, the agent bowls over a bandit.
Crushed under a toppled crate, the agent shifts shape and slips free.

reply.summary: Eosau is a once-celebrated keyboard virtuoso with a damaged hand, who was blackmailed by a twin into a life of theft and wishes to go straight. The gentle pianist is more tragic than dangerous.

feats.scene: Slamming a piano lid, the pianist traps a thug's fingers briefly.
Knocked out by a cloud of drowsy vapour, the pianist wakes hours later.

reply.summary: Tisres is a two-thousand-year-old northern conqueror with a bloody reputation, who pursued a defiant princess until a stranger from another age arrived. Armoured in lacquered plates, the warlord leads cavalry charges personally.

feats.scene: Cleaving with a curved sword, the warlord splits a shield and the arm behind it.
Struck by a spear thrown from a hill, the warlord stays in the saddle.

reply.summary: Valstu is a bald mad scientist with a giant smooth egg for a body and red eyes, bolted with machinery and fond of grand speeches. The inventor joins a gathering of brilliant minds as the laws of nature start to fray.

feats.scene: Firing a shoulder-mounted cannon, the egg-bodied inventor wrecks a lab bench and wall.
Rolled off a gantry onto stone, the shell holds without a crack.

reply.summary: Nuslitor is a young medicine woman who lost her family to a cruel injustice and turned her inherited rites into a weapon of vengeance. She can change her face, take the form of beasts and bend minds with a stare.

feats.scene: Chanting a curse, the sorceress hurls a swarm of spectral hawks that crack a window wall.
Buried beneath a collapsed building, the sorceress is feared dead.

reply.summary: Eostrn is a grieving young mother who lost her three-year-old son to a speeding car and could not carry the sorrow. Her quiet life of cooking, singing and tending a small garden ends in tragedy.

feats.scene: Hurling a vase against a wall, the mother shatters it in anguish.
Holding her son's small coat for a year, the mother endures longer than anyone knows.

reply.summary: Sernenu is a green-haired fallen deity of madness who once toppled a sunken empire and now sells sandwiches in a busy city after his source of magic went dark. A returning tide of sorcery tempts the owner back toward old habits.

feats.scene: Unleashing the full black tide, the deity drowns a sea-girt empire in a single night.
Ground down by years of exile, the shopkeeper simply keeps slicing meat.

reply.summary: Artenan is a masked revolutionary who seizes a nuclear submarine with her comrades and later is forced into a coerced team of disposable fighters. Quick fists and sharp training let the rebel break a larger fighter's nose.

feats.scene: Whipping a kick through the air, the rebel snaps a hostile soldier's jaw.
Flung against a bulkhead during a boarding, the rebel gets up and fights on.

reply.summary: Tauna is a green-haired lord of disorder with no eyes at all, who lends a stolen mantle of fate to a chosen host and hopes to spread confusion across the land. Matter, luck and reality itself bend when the immortal gestures.

feats.scene: Waving a hand, the lord flips every sign and street in a district upside down.
Struck by a pair of rival sorcerers, the lord loses a limb of mist and grows it back.

reply.summary: Linloiu is a red-haired gang boss who killed the owner of a power ring and wore it as a crown of violence. Thugs who fail the crook often die for it, until a rival finally takes the ring back.

feats.scene: Pointing the ring, the gangster blasts a hole in a steel warehouse door.
Shot in a rooftop ambush, the gangster stumbles and shoots back.

reply.summary: Ronton is a masked rider of an iron-wheeled war chariot who rolls through back streets with a gambler's crew, rattling shop windows and scattering pedestrians. Not much is recorded about the driver beyond a flair for noise.

feats.scene: Ramming a stone gatepost, the charioteer smashes it and the wheel rim.
Whipping the horses down a boulevard, the rider outpaces a taxi.

reply.summary: Iaresntu is a brown-eyed palace guard of a hidden island of warrior women, trained with bow, horse and sword and prone to bitter grudges. A trusted shield of the royal circle, the warrior takes her duty very seriously.

feats.scene: Swinging a bronze sword, the guard severs a training post in one stroke.
Struck by a thrown spear, the warrior turns it aside on her shield.

reply.summary: Tumllu is a hairless, tree-like giant from a far-off planet who joins a band of rebel fighters, strong, durable and nearly unbreakable. Few things can pierce the thick bark of the hulking soldier.

feats.scene: Swinging a gnarled arm, the giant smashes a bulkhead flat.
Hit by a heavy cannon at point-blank range, the giant sways and lumbers on.

reply.summary: Neosilll is a tall heiress who survived the murder of her entire family and plotted her revenge in a prison cell for years. Her vision for the city is a shining one, built on flames.

feats.scene: Slashing with a ceremonial blade, the schemer carves a deep cut into a wooden pillar.
Locked in solitary for years, the prisoner emerges with a cold smile.

reply.summary: Nitas is a white-haired emperor of a vast medieval realm, remembered for law, learning and an ever-growing family tree. Seated in a stone palace, the old monarch commands armies and scribes alike.

feats.scene: Swinging a battle sword on a campaign, the emperor hacks through a leather shield.
Thrown from his horse at a river ford, the monarch lands in the mud and laughs.

reply.summary: Coser is a script writer for a radio station in a grey, rain-swept port, accused of unpopular politics and crushed by the suspicion. A scholarship is later set up in the dead scribe's name.

feats.scene: Hammering the keys of a typewriter, the writer wakes the whole office at midnight.
Hounded by rumours for months, the writer finally breaks down.

reply.summary: Ronias is a gaudy criminal who rides a large kite-shaped glider and has become a running joke for a pacifist hero in a bragging story. The flyer is little threat but is forever returning.

feats.scene: Dropping from a glider, the criminal drives both heels into a guard.
Catching a stiff updraft, the flyer sails over a rail yard.

reply.summary: Lonteva is a young law firm intern who pulls on a glider cape and a mask to carry on the work of a famous night guardian. An early patrol goes badly, but quick thinking and a thrown knife save a partner.

feats.scene: Throwing a borrowed blade, the intern kills a coiled python in one cast.
Beaten by thugs in a warehouse, the intern feigns unconsciousness and waits.

reply.summary: Veost is a cheerful cab driver whose best friend is an occult trickster, who is infected by a plague of hollow hunger and lunges at his companion. A burning car and a quick escape end the nightmare.

feats.scene: Lunging at his old friend, the infected driver pins him against the car door.
Set alight by his horrified companion, the driver burns to nothing.

reply.summary: Liali is a roadie turned taxi driver and the oldest friend of a reckless occult hustler, who has survived by staying out of the magic. A last drive with a fake bomb ends in a fireball.

feats.scene: Slamming a car door on a heckler, the driver rattles the whole street.
Caught in the blast of a cab packed with explosives, the driver dies confused.

reply.summary: Talluse is a red-haired therapist and former asylum doctor who convinces himself that the citizens are brainwashed and begins hypnotising the patients he treats. A street artist becomes the public face of his manipulations.

feats.scene: Swinging a pendulum before a patient's eyes, the therapist puts him under in seconds.
Cornered in his studio, the therapist keeps a calm, steady smile.

reply.summary: Auloluium is a bald, loyal taxi driver who ferries a masked friend through crowded avenues in a battered cab with a pet name. The cabbie offers honest advice and does not judge anyone.

feats.scene: Cranking the wheel hard, the driver sideswipes a thug's getaway car.
Bumped by a speeding delivery van, the driver climbs out and waves it off.

reply.summary: Aulrnnto is a kind man with a clouded mind who works behind a corner shop counter and believes he is a caped crusader from an old television show. Neighbours happily play along, and the cheerful dreamer inspires a friend to clean up her life.

feats.scene: Swinging a broom handle, the clerk tangles a dealer's legs.
Beaten in an alley by hired heavies, the clerk stays down until the street rallies.

reply.summary: Cinseso is a quiet circuit engineer who once owed his life to a fellow soldier and repays the debt by adopting the man's orphaned son. A move to a friendlier town gives the boy a better life.

feats.scene: Hoisting a heavy transformer onto a bench, the engineer finishes the repair.
Hit by a stray bullet in battle, the soldier is carried to safety.

reply.summary: Esiela is a crime lord who rules much of a rainy capital, in a feud with a rival from the coal country and boasting of royal descent. Locked in a basement cell, the crook keeps tabs on his family's schemes.

feats.scene: Slamming a cane on the table, the boss makes his lieutenants flinch.
Held in a windowless cell for years, the boss still runs the streets by letter.

reply.summary: Riaanu is a dead monarch brought back by a lab and sent west with a crown of old grudges to conquer the realm again. Local cider makers hold the king at bay until the plot behind it is broken.

feats.scene: Raising a ceremonial sword, the revived king splits a barricade of barrels.
Struck by a thrown cask, the monarch merely stumbles.

reply.summary: Rnliurne is a loud, eccentric teenager obsessed with fantasy games and comic books who tells blunt jokes without noticing how they land. Passing a licence test at last, the teen slowly begins to worry about money and school.

feats.scene: Hurling a foam sword at a friend, the teen cracks a lamp shade.
Falling off a skateboard onto pavement, the teen rolls up grinning.

reply.summary: Stoliu is a patrolman who dresses in a motley suit with bells to confuse criminals with quips, claiming a court-fool ancestor. The funny crusader fights beside a band of wartime heroes until a final stand.

feats.scene: Whipping a baton in a tight arc, the patrolman drops two bandits.
Beaten in a back alley by a pack of robbers, the patrolman keeps joking.

reply.summary: Nancanu is a bright student in a boarding academy for young heroes who studies healing arts and carries a satchel of notes. Classmates call the diligent pupil a future medic with a talent for tests.

feats.scene: Tossing a textbook across the lecture hall, the student bonks a prankster.
Tumbling down the dormitory steps, the pupil collects the dropped notes.

reply.summary: Niuliaau is a sightless surgeon with a knack for finding his way through the dark who joins an old squad of veteran crimefighters. Medical training is his best tool and his handicap rarely slows him.

feats.scene: Landing a precise jab in the dark, the surgeon drops a startled guard.
Knocked down in a scuffle, the surgeon feels his way back to his feet.

reply.summary: Oseon is a blond forest worker with a head injury who comes to believe he is a purple-clad raider and leads a gang of costumed fakes. A friendly stretchy hero eventually restores the woodsman's memory.

feats.scene: Swinging a felling axe, the woodsman splits a log clean through.
Knocked on the head by a falling branch, the woodsman wakes with a new identity.

reply.summary: Valsor is a nine-foot, half-ton cyborg who longed from boyhood to carry rockets on his shoulders and abandoned his marriage to make it real. Sociopathic and sturdy, the mercenary brags that he could take over a whole continent.

feats.scene: Firing both shoulder rockets, the cyborg levels a small block of storefronts.
Shot at close range by a squad, the cyborg stays standing and survives.

reply.summary: Eoeonnan is a plucky, stocky young hero who turns into a rubbery ball and rebounds off walls to shrug off blows. Elected leader in the field, the cheerful bouncer is also a surprisingly good pilot.

feats.scene: Rebounding off three walls in a row, the bouncer slams into a robot guard.
Hit by a heavy hammer, the ball form bounces away unhurt.

reply.summary: Anucoeon is a blue-eyed scientist with a doctorate who can swell into a hard sphere and ricochet at great speed without ever being hurt. Persuaded to join a team of rebels, the physicist shows that bouncing is the whole point.

feats.scene: Careening off a wall, the ball form smashes through a row of crates.
Rammed by a heavy transport, the sphere shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Viciloro is a young engineer and ace pilot who designed a rounded spacecraft that can bounce harmlessly off other ships and walls. The official flier keeps a team of heroes aloft with careful repairs.

feats.scene: Ramming a rogue freighter at speed, the round ship pushes it aside.
Piloting the round craft out of orbit, the engineer rockets toward the sun.

reply.summary: Taust is a stocky young man who drank a strange plastic fluid by accident and can now inflate into a hard rolling sphere. Rejected twice by the hero club, he wins his place when his rubbery body defeats an electric villain.

feats.scene: Rolling into a squad of guards, the sphere bowls them down like pins.
Bounced off a steel wall at speed, the sphere is not even scuffed.

reply.summary: Irntaurn is a blond young rebel from a bleak future who was electrocuted in a factory brawl and became a being of living current. As a spy among the dictator's troops, the youth later flees with other rebels.

feats.scene: Hurling a bolt of power, the rebel blows apart a transformer station.
Streaking through the air as a charged streak, the rebel leaves a sparking trail.

reply.summary: Roelte is a shrewd frontier merchant who bought swampy tracts for pennies, land that later swelled into a great harbour city. His thriving enterprise passes to two sons when tuberculosis claims him in middle age.

feats.scene: Slamming a ledger shut, the merchant seals a bargain over a muddy field.
Wading through a swamp on survey, the merchant keeps his boots dry.

reply.summary: Nauiarnau is a wiry fighter pilot who keeps the radio shack humming on a hidden island base and mimics enemy officers over the airwaves. Multilingual and a sharp shot, the airman sings with the squadron on the way home.

feats.scene: Firing from the cockpit, the pilot knocks a gun from a captor's hand.
Diving in a propeller fighter, the pilot outruns an enemy interceptor.

reply.summary: Lunauam is a bodyguard who was mortally wounded and saved by a sorcerer who fused his body with that of a bear. The brown-haired adventurer has crushing strength, claws and a rage that is hard to hold.

feats.scene: Swinging a clawed fist, the bear-man caves in a car door.
Hit by a gunman's volley, the bear-man shakes off the bruises.
